description: OpenCompare quality gates: seven non-overlapping gates only — `install`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `build`, `build-web`, `test`, `test-debt-gate`. `test` is the single full-suite entry (`pnpm test`) and already collects every per-file suite, so the former single-file gate block was deleted instead of duplicated; no test file was removed. `perf:gate` / `perf:dir` never run here and live in the conditional `.munk/code-gates.perf.json` profile only. Each command is a single argv (no && || | ;), install and build stay separate, and `test-debt-gate` stays last as the read-only ratchet over the collected case floor.
